description: Regional climate change impact modelling for Mandurah, Western Australia is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Australian Ocean Data Network. This report describes a detailed assessment of coastal vulnerability and infrastructure exposure undertaken for Mandurah local government area (LGA) to complement the analyses in the National Coastal Risk Assessment. The assessment modelled both storm surge and coastal recession. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Australian Ocean Data Network. Its tags are Earth Sciences, GA Publication, Published_External, Record, climate. It offers 4 resource(s) in html, pdf, zip. The portal shows 2026-07-31 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
